1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 1 m de longitud, de cuerpo fuertemente comprimido, coloración plateada, aletas radiadas y espinas dorsales alargadas en la fase juvenil, encapsuladas en la piel en adultos. Carangidae, Alectis ciliaris.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 1 m in length, with a strongly compressed body, silvery coloration, radiated fins and elongated dorsal spines in the juvenile phase, which are encapsulated in the skin in adults. Family Carangidae, Alectis ciliaris.
